You see Deseus.
  • If you gaze long into an arena, the arena also gazes into you...
  • Take the battle to the horde!

Location

The Thais Monster Arena; access via Mystic Flame by depot on Main Street.

Notes

Deseus is the supervisor of the Monster Arena in Thais and therefore has to take care of its fighters.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Deseus.

Player: hi
Deseus: We both know you're here to fight hordes of monsters, so let's get to it. Just tell me if you're ready to {fight} or if you need me to {explain} something.
Player: explain
Deseus: I can give you details about how {waves} in the monster arena work and explain how to {initiate} a fight. I can also give you information on {prizes} and {fees}.
Player: waves
Deseus: First thing to know: dying here will not cost you anything, except the fee you need to pay for each match. ...
Deseus: After a fight has been {initiated} by giving me the necessary details, a timer will be started. ...
Deseus: If you can survive all waves of monsters, you may receive a {prize} and earn a place in the hall of fame. ...
Deseus: The fight will be cancelled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...
Deseus: If a wave is in progress but players take too long and cannot finish all monsters within the time limit, the fight will be cancelled as well.
Player: initiated
Deseus: Every premium player can participate in the monster arena. To initiate the first wave, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play. ...
Deseus: If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.
Player: prize
Deseus: Surviving a full battle over 10 waves will grant you a reward based on the difficulty level you have selected. Please talk to my assistant right next to the arena entrance for more information on how to claim your reward.
Player: initiate
Deseus: Every premium player can participate in the monster arena. To initiate the first wave, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play. ...
Deseus: If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.
Player: fees
Deseus: Initiating a fight against monsters in the arena will require an entrance fee of 1000 gold. Please make sure to have enough money on your bank account before setting up a fight.
Player: fight
Deseus: Good, let's do battle. Remember that you can {cancel} a setup any time. Are you ready to assemble your team?
Player: yes
Deseus: Which difficulty level shall it be, [{1}] (up to level 99), [{2}] (up to level 199), [{3}] (up to level 299), [{4}] (up to level 399) or [{5}] which can be played by all level ranges?
Player: 1/2/3/4/5
Deseus: So the difficulty will be 1/2/3/4/5. ...
Deseus: Please name all members of the team, including yourself by saying {me} if you want to take part, one by one. Note that each member must be online and that are no more than 5 players are allowed in a team.
Player: me
Deseus: You will be in the team, Player. ...
Deseus: You can add another player now. Let me know if you're {done}.
Player: done
Deseus: Alright! The team has been assembled. ...
Deseus: Are you ready to start the battle as soon as everyone has arrived in the anteroom?
Player: yes
Deseus: Let battle commence! Remember to enter the anteroom in time for the match to start!
Player: cancel
Deseus: In that case, all selections made have been cancelled. You can initialise a new {fight} any time you like. Please make sure that the initialisation process is not interrupted and that you have enough money on your bank account. (ends conversation)
Player: job
Deseus: Keeping the creatures down there in check mainly. And we have quite a lot of attractions to offer here. Don't you worry!
Player: name
Deseus: I am Deseus. Just D E S... ah never mind.
Player: time
Deseus: There is a time for talk and there is a time for battle. Now is not the time for talk.
Player: bye
Deseus: Good fight, good night.

Deseus
